hosting._comment_base: The /d/... prefix must match DEMO_BASE in src/demoBase.ts. JSON cannot import it, so scripts/verify-build.mjs asserts the two agree and npm run build fails if they drift. Scoping the rewrite to the base path also means Firebase 404s the site root rather than serving a bundle that then declines to render.
hosting._comment_headers: Header `source` globs match the REQUEST path, not the rewritten one. A rule on **/index.html never fires, because every screen is requested as /d/<base>/... and only rewritten to index.html afterwards. So no-cache is the default and only hashed assets opt into a long cache, otherwise the SPA entry is cached for an hour and a redeploy mid-research-session is invisible.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
